body:
Follow-up to `robofab-grasp` (its "lift and acceleration loads" next step). The jaws accelerate up or sideways at up to 40 m/s²; the minimum holding force from MuJoCo is compared with the analytic bound over 77 cases (ratio 0.99–1.07). Fidelity finding: the 0.004 s contact time constant used for the static test reports slip at any force once the jaws accelerate; 0.0005 s is needed. Stylised, simulation only. 7 tests; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
